sentences: Imagine ordering a phone charger and seeing it land in your backyard from the sky less than an hour later.
Amazon hopes to make this normal in Tallahassee, where it plans to start drone **deliveries** in mid-November if a building permit is approved in time.
Up to twenty-one drones will fly from a **warehouse** in the city, and each one can carry a package that **weighs** up to five pounds to homes within seven and a half miles.
**Supporters** say the service could save people a trip to the store, since some orders may arrive in as little as thirty minutes.
en.answer: 휴대폰 충전기를 주문했는데 한 시간도 안 돼서 그것이 하늘에서 뒷마당으로 내려오는 모습을 본다고 상상해 보라.
